Generated by `fli ws:exports`. **Do not edit.**

What each publishable package actually ships, and whether every entry point it
declares is inside that. An app in this repo resolves a sibling to
`packages/<name>/` and never to a `node_modules` path, so nothing here runs the
published shape — `FJS-251` broke every npm install past 836 green tests.

Top-level entries only, because that is the granularity `files:` works at: a
directory that stops being published is a line that vanished, and adding a
source file inside one changes nothing. Versions are absent on purpose — a
release moves sixteen at once, and a file that changes every release is a file
nobody reads on the release that matters.

it is invisible from inside this repo.
